name: When should I repair ceiling drywall myself versus hiring a professional?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair ceiling drywall myself versus hiring a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small cracks or minor holes, typically less than a few inches, can often be addressed by an experienced homeowner with basic tools and patching compounds. However, if the damage is extensive, involves water damage, structural issues, or covers a large area, hiring a professional is recommended. Professionals ensure proper preparation, seamless repairs, and address underlying issues, which can prevent future problems and maintain home value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor damage can be DIY; extensive water damage, structural issues, or large areas require professional repair.
